notes.title: A Hero's Rest Celebrates the Holidays with Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Town Managers!

The holidays are upon us, and we're bringing gifts to A Hero's Rest! We're thrilled to announce the release of Patch 1.2, packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your town-building experience.

But that's not all! From [b]December 22nd to January 5th, 2025[/b], players can unlock unique, [b]limited-time seasonal decorations[/b] to deck their towns with festive cheer. And to top it off, A Hero's Rest will be available at a [b]35% discount[/b] during this period, making it the perfect time to embark on your own RPG town-building adventure!

Read on for the full patch notes for Version 1.2:[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Features:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Increased Maximum Active Classes:[/b][/h3][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d27224b68730761628e8746c5c348b3e83a76c3c.png[/img]
[*]The total number of active classes has been increased to [b]10[/b] up from [b]8[/b] when the Training Grounds are built.
[*]This provides greater creative freedom when designing your unique classes.[/list]
[h3][b]Improved Production Farms:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/aa04c6a4fd1b255089ba2be3536c6ce884cdaeaa.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Vendors can now not only restock but also harvest ready Production Farms.
[*]A new "Automatically Harvest & Restock" option has been added to the vendor details panel. Enabling this will make vendors automatically harvest and restock farms.
[*]Vendors will only perform these actions if sufficient gold and resources are available.
[*]Because these actions take time, consider adding more displays or vendor counters to keep customers occupied while vendors are busy.[/list]
[h3][b]Holiday Event (December 22nd, 2024 - January 5th, 2025):[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Log in during the holiday period to [b]permanently unlock[/b] exclusive seasonal decorations for your town![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d18461a4e164f3fcf6eddfb16e0ce9d99142d986.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][h3][b]Changes & Improvements:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]The display of lifetime profit in the details menu now supports values in the millions.
[*]Improved the way Template items display the classes that are using them in the inventory.
[*]Optimized pathfinding for heroes within the town.
[*]Improved Loading of Textures for Item Displays.[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where heroes would sometimes get stuck sitting.
[*]Resolved a bug that caused incorrect item prices to be displayed in certain shops.
[*]Fixed a rare crash that could occur when rapidly switching between town menus.[/list][hr][/hr]
I hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. Happy holidays, and happy town building!

Loke

notes.title: A Hero's Rest: v1.0 The Dawn of a New Age
notes.notes:
Greetings noble proprietors of Felonia!

After a dedicated four-year development journey, including two years in Early Access, we're thrilled to unveil Version 1.0 of A Hero's Rest. Shaped by the feedback from our community, this full release marks a significant milestone in the game's evolution & here is the trailer for our 1.0 Launch.
[previewyoutube=i7qLWw1GyNg;full][/previewyoutube]
We are extremely thankful to all those who supported us during Early Access. Your enthusiasm and insights have been instrumental in crafting a world that surpasses our initial expectations. As we embark on this new chapter, we're excited to see what the future holds for A Hero's Rest.[hr][/hr]
The world of A Hero's Rest has changed forever. Patch 1.0 brings a wave of exciting new features and improvements, transforming your town into a dynamic and ever-evolving realm.

[h1][b]New Lands, New Adventures[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f4b3b7ace4831048edacad334d231893e6a5c3d9.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Map: Standfort Bay[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Explore a coastal paradise teeming with opportunities and challenges. Featuring four entry points and a grand fortress, this map offers a unique experience.
[*]Don't let your guard down as the threats of Felonia lurk around every corner, demanding your strategic prowess.
[*]Standfort Bay marks the conclusion of Milestone 4 and the gateway to A Hero's Rest's full release.[/list]
[h1][b]Survive the elements[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/b6168e6438a93189ae295dac02cd2acef284f46a.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Feature: Dynamic Seasons[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Weather now affects your town in profound ways, demanding strategic adaptation.
[*]From bountiful summers to harsh winters, your management skills will be put to the test.
[*]Dynamic quest rewards: Quests adapt to the current season, offering unique rewards and challenges.
[*]Storms and blizzards are more dangerous than ever, affecting Hero quests and your town's well-being.
[*][b]Choose your difficulty:[/b] Dynamic Seasons feature three difficulty variants, including a challenging Survival Mode for those seeking a true test.[/list]
[h1][b]Harness the Power of Nature[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/bbc97c501b6d86c493d2326d51b07e96b6767648.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Class Attribute: Wisdom[/b][/h3][list]
[*]The new Wisdom attribute allows Heroes to cast powerful healing spells, providing essential support to your team.
[*]The Wisdom Stat replaces the Magic Stat in items, offering new possibilities for character builds.
[*]Wisdom heroes can use "Mending Hands" to restore the Health and Mana of allied Heroes in town, boosting their challenge rating at the cost of their own.
[*]Wisdom Heroes are invaluable in raid parties, providing critical support and improving your success chances.
[*]Experience a unique set of animations and spells designed specifically for Wisdom Heroes.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improve your Heroes' Growth[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f9bb58be94b3a8ff39131879b7ace67457659fdc.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Specialization: Weapon Master[/b][/h3][list]
[*]The Weapon Master now features a Specialization menu with [b]12[/b] new perks to bolster your Heroes' prowess even further.
[*]The specialization menu is unlocked once the player builds the Training Grounds.
[*]The Specialization menu can be accessed through the normal Weapon Master Menu, a new button has been added to facilitate that.
[*]Unlike the other stations the Weapon Master perk tiers are unlocked by the current amount of active classes at the weapon master (they don't necessarily need to be actively recruiting).
[*]The perks will stay active once selected even if the player removes some of his current classes. Resetting the perk tree will require the player to re-establish active classes to unlock their corresponding perk tier.
[*]If the player removes the Training Grounds Station, all its perk effects will be removed and restored once the player chooses to rebuild the station.
[*]A new Mutator has been added to allow the player to make the cost of training [b]New Classes[/b] Free.
[/list]
[h1][b]A Growing Hero Population[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a5921ef613c8ac427c9c54a9ffc85d1b593f6050.png[/img]
[h3][b]Increased Hero Population Cap: Expand Your Roster[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Choose your challenge and manage from 50, up to [b]120[/b] Heroes for a more complex and rewarding experience.
[*] This experimental feature offers a new level of challenge and strategic depth but may have some performance implications in lower-end systems.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Combat Animations & Customization[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/005727d5f0dfae94b834a8f6b01fa520004cdac4.gif[/img][list]
[*]Enjoy over 60 new combat animations, including a remake of two-handed sword animations, new attacks for staff users, and more.
[*]Watch your Heroes grow stronger and more confident as their Combat Rating improves.
[*] 5 new class badges have been added to further customize your Heroes' Classes.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Milestones and Objectives[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/baa012634799d2b3e3f549d157fb044ae0bbfed0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Embark on new Challenges[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Complete [b]12[/b] new milestones and their corresponding achievements.
[*]Enjoy a wider variety of objectives as you progress through the game.
[*][b]Note:[/b] New milestones are not retroactive, so you may need to complete their objective again (if you already have) to unlock them.[/list]
[h1][b]Unleash Your Creativity[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/6cd2897d5438d7df57570ea1819896d91fa2dfe8.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Items:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Customize your shops with 13 new items, including walls, decorations, and a new upgrade with the improved Building and User Interface.
[/list]
[h1][b]Improved Gameplay & 4k Support[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a3c1d19b55863e424c7a464faf927e7c544ade5b.png[/img]
[h3][b]An improved Experience[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Enjoy improved visuals and performance on 4k High-resolution displays.
[*]Easily craft and complete visitor orders, directly from your ledger or workstations.
[*]The building menu has been improved to accommodate more building options.
[*]Some inventory tooltips have been improved for better visibility.
[*]And many more...
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Changes and Improvements[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Map Enhancements[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Improved aesthetics and navigation on various maps.
[*]The "A New Beginning" map received a major overhaul, with a focus on improving the town center and overall visual appeal.
[*]Added wooden fences to paths in Mountain Pass for improved aesthetics.
[*]Changed the Resources Notification from collecting resources from trees around the maps to make it easier to see.[/list]
[h3][b]Crafter Balance[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Reduced the effects of the Transmutation Cost Mutator under the "High" Setting as it made transmutation way too expensive.
[*]Balanced crafting costs for T2, T3, and T4 Cloth, Medium, and Heavy Armors.
[*]Crafters will now grant increasing Royalty Tokens rewards when leveling up, as the Item Tier increases.
[*]Added a new Button to access the quest log to the Quest Crafting Menu.[/list]
[h3][b]Crafter Perks[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Reverted the Apothecary Distillery to being a unique Item in your Shop, Instead it now provides between 1-3 Potions on each activation.
[*]Removed the Apothecary's Perk "Infused Orb" and replaced it with stronger counterparts now being Tier 2 & 3 Perks.
[*]Removed the Apothecary's Perk "Jewelcrafting" and replaced it with stronger counterparts now being Tier 2 & 3 Perks.
[*]Added a new Tier 4 Apothecary Perk "Potion Master" to increase the amount of potions received from the Distillery.
[*]Added a new Tier 4 Apothecary Perk "Genetic Engineering" to increase the Effect of Compost by 20%.
[*]Removed the Tailor's perk "Crystalized Dragon Essence" and replaced it with "Master Weaver" to increase the efficiency of the Spinning Frame by 20%.
[*]Removed the Tanner's perk "Crystalized Dragon Essence" and replaced it with "Hide Expert" to increase the efficiency of the Leather Soaking Tub by 20%.
[*]Increased the effect of the Blacksmith's perk "Miner's Diary" from 15% to 20%.
[*]Increased the effect of the Woodworker's perk "Reforestation" from 15% to 20%.[/list]
[h3][b]Crafter Upgrades[/b][/h3][list]
[*]All Tier 2 Upgrades related to visitors now require an additional workstation to unlock.[/list]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Selecting a Difficulty in the mutator's Menu will automatically select a preset of settings for that difficulty, which can, of course, be further customized.
[*]All existing games will show as Custom Difficulty and will keep whatever settings they had.
[*]Improved Hit Detection in various interactable Upgrades.
[*]Improved Hit Detection for various floating Menus.
[*]Expected Visitors are more likely to appear than before.
[*]Added Tooltips to the sort buttons in the Inventory Menu.
[*]The Main Menu will now display the latest news related to A Hero's Rest.
[*]Added an option to the settings menu to accelerate the legendary crafting animation.
[*]When hovering over quest rewards in the Inventory & Hero List Menus, if the reward is being modified by any source, it will now display the sources affecting it.
[*]When selecting an object that can be interacted by Heroes/Visitors, new visual indications will show if the item is accessible to them.
[*]You can now switch the Recruiting State of classes straight from the Weapon Maseter's Menu, an improved Class Button provides greater information on each class.
[*]The Invocation Stage no longer requires the "Woodworker Station" to build, but instead requires 4 active classes.
[*]Added tooltips for the resources requested in the Royal Request Order.
[*]Improved Visuals & performance of the Weapon Master's Menu.
[*]The existing Stone fence was renamed to Simple Stone Fence.
[*]The Beer Keg can now provide between 1-3 Beers per activation.
[*]Exterior Lamp Post Gold cost reduced.
[*]Improved the Removal and movement of floors.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some items would display empty Pictures in the Inventory Window.
[*]Fixed a bug where some threats would take Focus Gems as resources when failed.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Grass Patches to affect Heroes' pathfinding.
[*]Fixed a bug when changing classes that showed the incorrect progress of the class change.
[*]Fixed a bug where some items would stay coloured red in some situations.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Items like the beer keg and some others to be placed in the same spot as existing objects.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Heroes to fail to respec classes under some circumstances.
[*]Fixed a bug with the raid progress not showing in the threat's menu when loading a game.
[*]Fixed a bug where the workstation menu wouldn't show up while the game was paused.
[*]Fixed a flashing UI bug happening when trying to view the recipe tooltips with the game paused.
[*]Fixed a bug when switching items in the crafting menu while the item category is ready to be leveled up.
[*]And more...[/list][hr][/hr]
The world of A Hero's Rest awaits! With Patch 1.0, you'll discover new lands, face challenging enemies, and build your dream town. The future of your heroic journey is now in your hands.

Happy Questing!
Loke & Chaya

notes.title: Sneak Peek - 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

Get ready for an epic journey as we are less than 2 weeks away from the full release of A Hero's Rest! To give you a taste of what's to come, we're excited to unveil some of the thrilling new features and improvements included in the upcoming 1.0 patch.

[h3][b]Introducing Standfort Bay[/b][/h3]
Venture into the uncharted territory of Standfort Bay, a coastal town with four unique entry points and a grand fortress. This new map offers a fresh experience and marks the conclusion of [b]Milestone 4[/b], leading to the full release of A Hero's Rest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f4b3b7ace4831048edacad334d231893e6a5c3d9.png[/img]
While the town may appear sturdy and inviting, don't be fooled by its appearance. The dangers of Felonia lurk around every corner, and you'll need to be vigilant to protect your town.[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Dynamic Seasons:[/b][/h3]
Prepare for changing weather conditions that will impact your Heroes from Thunderstorms and blizzards affecting your Heroes' chances of success to stacking resources during Bountiful Summers before facing the Harsh Winter. Dynamic Seasons will bring a new challenge to test your skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/b6168e6438a93189ae295dac02cd2acef284f46a.png[/img]
Customize your experience with the varying levels of difficulty, each altering the way Seasons affect your gameplay.[list]
[*][b]Normal:[/b] A balanced gameplay experience with seasonal effects offering both opportunities and challenges.
[*][b]Hard:[/b] A more challenging adventure where the seasons have a greater impact on your town. Seasons will provide significant rewards as well as harsh penalties.
[*][b]Survival:[/b] A demanding test of your survival skills. Each passing year will intensify the seasonal challenges, requiring exceptional resource management and strategic planning.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]The New Wisdom Attribute:[/b][/h3]
Expand your tactical options with the introduction of the Wisdom core attribute. These Heroes bring unique abilities focused on support and healing, ensuring your Heroes are ready to undertake any challenge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/bbc97c501b6d86c493d2326d51b07e96b6767648.png[/img]
While their direct damage may be lower than other classes, their support is invaluable. Spells like Mending Hands can restore health and mana to your Heroes, making Wisdom Heroes a formidable addition to your roster.[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]And More![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Weapon Master Specializations:[/b] Customize your Heroes' prowess even further with 12 new perks available through the new specialization menu to aid your Heroes' Growth.
[*][b]Increased Hero Population Cap:[/b] Increase the size of your Hero roster up to 120 Heroes! And take your management skills to the next level.
[*][b]New Combat Animations and Class Badges:[/b] Enjoy improved visuals and customize your Heroes' classes with new animations and badges.
[*][b]Brand New Items:[/b] Enhance your shop with 13 new items, including walls, floors, decorations, and a new upgrade.
[*][b]Improved Building Menu and UI:[/b] Experience a more user-friendly interface with enhancements to the building menu and various UI elements.
[*][b]New Milestones and Objectives:[/b] Embark on new challenges and track your progress with additional milestones and objectives.[/list][hr][/hr]
We can't wait to unveil more on release and for you to experience all that A Hero's Rest has to offer in the 1.0 release.

Happy Questing,
Loke & Chaya

notes.title: Patch Notes Version v0.935.27
notes.notes:
Greetings, Champions!

[b]Prepare for our biggest update yet![/b] v0.935.27 brings a wealth of new content and long-awaited features, including the challenging Raid System, a brand new tier of equipment, a revamped itemization system, and a thrilling conclusion to the captivating story of A Hero's Rest. Sharpen your swords, stock up on potions, and get ready to embark on legendary adventures!

[b]Patch Notes Version v0.935.27:[/b]

[h1][b]Prepare for Epic Adventures: Raids Arrive![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3c92d2a8abfe4d97c264262767ec02cf53c36be9.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Quest Type: Raids[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Face the ultimate test with 6 challenging Raids, each featuring a unique boss, requirements, and legendary rewards.
[*]Assemble your most powerful party of 4 Heroes and meet the Raid's entry criteria to face the challenge.
[*]Utilize Royal Tokens to dispatch your raiding party and conquer the Raid for even greater rewards and subsequent Raids.
[*]Strategize your approach – re-roll Raid difficulty and rewards using Focus Gems for the perfect challenge.
[*]Witness your Heroes embark on their Raid – follow their progress and await their triumphant return (or face the consequences of failure!).
[*]Raids offer the ultimate rewards – legendary loot, powerful Mythical item upgrades, prestigious Medals with unique bonuses, and epic Titles for your Heroes.
[*]Conquer Raids repeatedly to test your might and acquire ever-greater spoils.
[*]Learn more about Raids with the new Compendium pages.[/list]
[h1][b]Unveiling Mythical Gear: A New Peak in Power[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/0836f063ec9ca3077e75987590baa1f5168235aa.gif[/img]
[h3][b]New Item Rarity: Mythical[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Ascend to new heights with Mythical Gear, the pinnacle of equipment for your Heroes.
[*]Acquire Mythical Gear exclusively from conquering Raids – Tier 4, best-in-slot equipment awaits!
[*]Mythical Gear boasts a unique colour scheme and significantly boosts your Heroes' stats.
[*]Similar to Legendary items, Mythical Gear cannot be upgraded with Regrade Stones.
[*]Crafting Mythical Gear through traditional means is extremely unlikely.[/list]
[h1][b]Itemization 2.0: A Refined Experience[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8b84af40a9b13e09cfbac00a950dcffde2ca3efc.png[/img]
[h3][b]Items 2.0 & Hero Upgrade Logic Overhaul[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]We've revamped the entire item system to provide a clearer and more balanced experience.
[*]Items now accurately reflect their worth based on quality – higher quality within the same tier reigns supreme.
[*]Heroes prioritize higher quality items of previous tiers when evaluating potential upgrades, preventing illogical swaps.
[*]Item values across all tiers have been recalibrated to reflect this system. Expect broken and normal items to be less effective compared to higher quality lower-tier items, especially Epics and Legendaries.
[*]Heroes are more likely to keep Legendary gear when considering upgrades.
[*]Once Heroes surpass the 65 CR range, they become less likely to complain about their equipment altogether.
[*]Regrading has been reworked to enhance all item stats instead of adding a single new stat.
[*]A chance for partial upgrades exists – items may receive stat boosts without a quality increase, allowing for further improvement.
[*]New upgrade effects and sounds add a touch of flair to the enhancement process.
One-handed weapons and off-hands have had their stats halved to align with their two-handed counterparts. Shields remain unaffected.[/list]
[h1][b]Crafting Convenience: Automatic Crafting[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/7f4cf4992f566805e0fa10eae05adec3d5658a36.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Automatic Crafting Slots[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Sit back and relax with the new Automatic Crafting system!
[*]The Innkeeper and Apothecary gain crafting slots as their stations level up.
[*]Utilize these slots to automatically craft items as they are purchased, provided you have the necessary materials.
[*]Crafting triggers whenever your stock dips below 15 items, ensuring a well-supplied inventory.
[*]The crafter prioritizes crafting missing items, preventing unnecessary clutter.
[*]Reserved items for specific Heroes are taken into account, ensuring their consumables are restocked.[/list]
[h1][b]Embrace Your Core: Enhanced Attributes[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/2dd4c210387bcb8cda7fc2276c2d8bfe758178b9.png[/img]
[h3][b]Core Attribute Traits[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Core attributes now have a greater impact on Hero development.
[*]Each Core Attribute boasts new Traits, adding depth and strategic variety to your Hero roster.
[*]Combine these effects with Gear proficiencies to create truly unique Hero builds.
[*]Mastering team composition will be vital for conquering the new Raids![/list]
[h1][b]A Fitting Conclusion: Achievements & Story[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f42d97924854d8641da36e1d04da210c74ffae64.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Achievements & Plot Conclusion[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Seven new platform-specific Achievements celebrate your Raid victories.
[*]New events bring the game's story to a conclusion, complete with its own platform-specific Achievement.
[*]Existing story events have been polished for a smoother narrative flow.[/list]
[h1][b]Quest Dynamics & More[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/1767baf0a82798b8718ef2ed21ae41c3e776ef8d.png[/img]
[h3][b]Quest Changes & Honorable Mentions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New quest dynamics add a fresh layer of strategy to your quest selection.
[*]Slay quests remain the top earner for Hero XP and Gold, propelling your Heroes' growth.
[*]Gather quests offer increased material profit due to a lower listing cost, but come with slightly lower Gold and XP rewards for your Heroes.
[*]A new Threat bar keeps you informed of your proximity to a boss encounter during Slay quests.
[*]Tooltips have been updated to reflect these changes.
[*]The King has grown more patient, offering "Grace Days" when your town's reputation is "At Risk." This allows you time to recover and avoid negative consequences. Check the reputation tooltip for details.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Crafters:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Innkeeper and Apothecary base experience per craft has been reduced to [b]32/64/100[/b] (down from [b]48/78/100[/b]).
[*]Potion Distilleries are no longer unique and no longer provide Debilitating Potions as bonus potions.
[*]Debilitating Potions have been removed due to redundancy and replaced with Lesser and Greater Potions of Fortune, increasing Hero's earned Gold during adventures by [b]25%[/b] and [b]50%[/b] respectively.
[*]Potions of Confidence and Resistance have received new icons due to the addition of the new potions.
[*]Lesser Potion of protection is now a [b]tier 2[/b] Potion up from [b]tier 1[/b].
[*]A new mutator allows you to adjust how many automatic Crafting slots crafters receive upon leveling up.
[*]Pop-ups for station level-up buttons are now larger and more readable.
[*]New Notifications will highlight crafters with unused perks.
[*]Improved visuals for the detail panel.
[*]Quests now display objective icons while browsing your inventory.
[*]Crafting recipes now display icons when browsing your inventory.
[*]The Weapon Master's Class Menu has improved visuals.
[*]Raid Gold rewards contribute to the Innkeeper's profit and Season Summary score.[/list]
[h3][b]General:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Buttons for starting or canceling the tutorial in "Letter from Mr. George" have been swapped.
[*]Streamlined and improved tooltips throughout the game for better readability and understanding.
[*]Enhanced UI elements for improved readability and comprehension.
[*]The Hero List Menu now displays CR and current quests for Heroes in the General List.
[*]The Hero Population icon is now a button allowing you to switch between Hero Population and current town population.
[*]Improved aesthetics and performance of the Hero List Menu.
[*] The Main Menu Logo has been changed.[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Trader's Mystery Box rewards have been increased, and the cost has been reduced. It now features a rare chance for a Jackpot.
[*]Increased the maximum number of Heroes that can appear in town simultaneously at different reputation levels.
[*]Legendary Imminent Threats now provide Royalty Tokens in addition to their original rewards.
[*]Holding down the ALT key (default) displays all Hero name tags. This key can be changed in the keybinds menu.
[*]A new option in the pause menu allows you to toggle the permanent display of Hero name tags.
[*]Name tags now include the Hero's class icon.
[*]Heroes automatically equip titles earned through the Medal reward system. An option to disable this feature is available in the settings menu.
[*]When a Hero levels up, a report appears in the Report Box.
[*]Improved how Heroes choose their food and potions.
[*]The effects of the INT Core Attribute on Royal Tokens have been reduced.
[*]Increased visitor approval gain from fulfilling orders. This effect decays slower as well.
[*]Changes made to previous appearances of Vera Suzuran lore.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed a comma from the Core Difficulty Settings tooltip.
[*]Fixed a bug where Hero behaviour in the Hero list wouldn't update while paused.
[*]Fixed a bug where visitors stopped spawning when the maximum number of Heroes in town was reached.
[*]Fixed a bug with the talent that provides a bonus chance to craft Legendary items.
[*]Fixed a bug where respecing a Hero sometimes resulted in higher quality Training Weapons than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Hero Manager wouldn't display the Hero with the lowest CR accurately.
[*]Fixed a bug where Normal (Blue) Threats sometimes penalized the player more than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug during crafting that caused players to receive the wrong amount of items.
[*]Fixed a bug where Heroes weren't receiving extra Gold while questing off-screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Trade Route tooltip displayed incorrect information.
[*]Fixed various minor bugs.[/list][hr][/hr]
Happy Questing!

We hope you enjoy this exciting update to A Hero's Rest!

Loke & Chaya

[*]Trade Routes will appear in your Town Ledger after defeating a Boss & having Sam the Trader visit your Town.
[*]Sam The Trader will introduce the Trade Route system on his first visit and will inform you of any new trade route opportunities.
[*]Trade Routes require a small challenge to be completed before they can be set up. Once completed, the Trade Route can be put to use and repurposed at will without the need of completing any further challenges.
[*]To initiate a Trade Route, you will need to choose a Shop and Tier of the Items to trade for. After paying the upkeep cost, the Trade Route will start.
[*]Every time a Trade Route is completed, a random Item of Quality Normal or better, of the Tier of your choice, will be delivered to your shop's Inventory.
[*]You can pause Trade Routes at any time, or rush them to finish them instantly using a Focus Gem (which can be bought at the Trader for Royal Tokens).
[*]Every time an item is delivered a message will appear in the Report Window. If an item fails to be delivered, the reason will be shown in the Trade Route itself.
[*]Trade Routes will continue to deliver Items unless you stop them, can't afford them, or have no stock space. They will automatically resume if all their requirements are met.
[*]Trade Routes can be an excellent tool to keep your shops stocked!

[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Heroes Quest Behaviour:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/98e33e54f17c413591f18900b3ca20839a1b02fa.png[/img]
[list][*]The Hero's Quest Behaviour dictates how Heroes choose their Quest before going on an Adventure.
[*]There are [b]4[/b] Behaviours to choose from - [b]Coward, Calculated, Brave & Heroic[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/97eb5fec993038a2a1e13cd0eab9ae48cbfbb622.gif[/img]
[*]You can switch your Hero's Behaviour by clicking on the new Behaviour Button in the Hero Sheet or through the Hero List.
[*]With the addition of the new Quest Behaviour System, overwhelming Quests had their completion bonus drastically increased!
[*]This new system allows you to send your heroes to take on more powerful Quests for greater rewards!

[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Hero Retirement:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3d2866d85f0bdc9f9df8d09347b9696f6c9a7367.png[/img]
[list][*]Heroes may now be retired from your Roster by selecting them in your Town and clicking the "Retire Hero" - Button, that has been added to the Hero Sheet.
[*]Heroes that are retired from adventuring will award you with Regrade Stones based on the Tier and quality of their Gear.
[*]Retiring a Hero will permanently remove them from your Roster.

[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Changes & Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The Compendium has been updated to include the new features and changes.
[*]Increased the chance to upgrade a Tier 4 Item using Regrade Stones by [b]10%[/b].
[*]Reduced the amount of Visitor Requests to make it less spammy.
[*]Increased the likelihood Visitor Requests will require food over Potions.
[*]Doubled the Time given to complete Visitor Requests.
[*]Increased the maximum amount of Resources that can be transmuted at once to [b]25[/b] per stack.
[*]Tier 4 Materials will now transmute to [b]Tier 3[/b] Regrade Stones instead of [b]Tier 4[/b] to improve game balance with newly added mechanics.
[*]A new and improved Hero Sheet will allow you to access more of your Hero's Information with ease.
[*]Added Tooltips to Items in the Inventory Menu to improve the overall browsing experience.
[*]Added Tier Level Indications to tooltips at the Trader, Recycle Station, and more...
[*]Improved the readability of the Shop's Detail Panel & other UI Elements.

[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that Item Tooltips would display 1 point more on their main stat. This did not affect CR calculations.
[*]Fixed a bug where the shop's detail panel would sometimes not show the lifetime profit.
[/list]


Happy Questing!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.620.27 Red Mist
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Sharpen those swords and brew some potions to prepare your Heroes for this next update: Introducing the new Event - Red Mist!

From time to time the mysterious Red Mist will gather and empower some of the fiends of Felonia. Ensure your Heroes are up to the task, because if they succeed, they will return with even greater rewards!



[b]Patch Notes version v0.620.27:[/b]

[h1][b]New event - Red Mist:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d3565f30ffc280c16e4ee4efddeed4e98a942da8.png[/img][list][*]Red Mist is a new random event that can happen in your town.

[*]The Red Mist effects will affect all questing Heroes as long as the Red Mist is active, even if the quest started before the mist affected the corresponding objectives.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/6e5a462feca01f91e68c235b2d2c3ae05da8331e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/abecfd056cae3021d3957818c850618e7e014ca9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/02710c1b31f39668ad1b433d36fd0085969add40.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Improved building system! Allowing you to re-place walls in a similar fashion to how replacing floors works, making the change of decoration a much more pleasant task.
[*]New Construction options with over 30 new pieces including new variations & a new set of walls, floors & doors for you to decorate your environments.
[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Changes & Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]New UI Elements were added to highlight Boss & Red Mist Quests.
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where a prompt to take photos wouldn't appear in the Town Ledger.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Default hotkey for the town ledger was (Numpad 6) instead of standard (6) (this will not affect existing games)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Version v0.560.27 Visitors' Overhaul
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's time for our next big Update!

This time we're introducing a whole new System to flesh out the regular visitors coming to your Town, new Upgrades, new Furniture, and more!

Get ready to decorate and have fun!



[b]Patch Notes version v0.560.27:[/b]

[h1][b]New Features:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Town Ledger[/b][/h3]

With this Patch, we are introducing a new Menu, the [b]Town Ledger[/b]. You can access your Town's Ledger by pressing [b][6][/b] or clicking the Icon next to your retired Heroes.

Within this Menu, there are multiple things you will be able to accomplish.[hr][/hr]
[h3]Visitors' Orders:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Visitors will now request special orders from time to time when they visit the Inn.
[*]Fulfilling Visitors' Orders will increase the Visitors' satisfaction. Higher satisfaction will lead to your visitors leaving Tips when buying Items in your Town.
[*]You can view all available Visitors' Orders and their current satisfaction in the Town Ledger or while crafting at the Innkeeper and the Apothecary.
[*]Orders are optional and will periodically appear in your ledger. They can be a great way to boost the gold income from visitors' purchases.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/71a8bb4bf7062d1e79081629eb8a14469fa22454.png[/img]
[h3]Expected Visitors:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Expected Visitors tab will allow you to add your own custom Heroes to appear organically in your town.
[*]You can use the tabs in the menu to assign specific names to your Visitors / Heroes and have your friends and characters from your favourite games join the town as fresh adventuring Heroes.
[*]Names can be removed and switched at any time.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e855f5d5796372c70dcfdff74ab66434a6abd42f.png[/img]
[h3]Photo Gallery:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Selecting the Photo Gallery will allow you to re-visit your favourite moments in your town.
[*]Whenever you take a picture with the Photo Mode [b]H[/b] (default), it will be added to the Photo Gallery.
[*]Pictures in your Photo Gallery will appear in the loading screens and when placing down Framed Paintings in your Town's Shops.
[*]You can expand any picture in the Photo Gallery by clicking on them or permanently delete them by pressing the small X in the top right corner of every thumbnail.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/c74a777908f6ff76f97cae5f17b191ab86a5cd24.png[/img]
[h3]Compendium:[/h3]
[list]
[*]A New Compendium Page has been dedicated to the Town Ledger.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]New Furniture:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d34f1335ddef292642e39fc4549d5e17799e143e.png[/img]
A range of new items have been added to the game:
[list]
[*]You can find [b]over a dozen[/b] new Furniture Items in all building categories including sofas, counters & shop signs.
[*]A total of [b]6[/b] new Shops for your visitors in the upgrades tab provide new services for your visitors.
[*]A new grass patch can be used to place grass around your shops.
[*]A new Category has been added to the build menu [b]"Decorations"[/b] to improve the menu's navigation.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]New Station Upgrades:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/0052ae1d2cf0bfb139414c8d38377245e3718bed.gif[/img]
Each workstation can now be upgraded with a new set of Shops for Visitors.
[list]
[*]The [b]Innkeeper [/b]can now be upgraded with a [b]Cartographer[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Wood[/b] to sell Maps to your Visitors and make sure they (hopefully) never lose their way.
[*]The [b]Apothecary [/b]can now be upgraded with a [b]Dried Herb Rack[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Herbs[/b] to sell some dried spices for your Visitors' home cooking.
[*]The [b]Blacksmith[/b] can now be upgraded with a [b]Potshop[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Metal[/b] to supply your visitors' kitchens with knives, pots, pans, and more!
[*]The [b]Woodworker [/b]can now be upgraded with a [b]Furniture Stand[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Wood[/b] to provide your Visitors' with some basic furniture to take home.
[*]The [b]Tanner [/b]can now be upgraded with a [b]Leather Goods Shop[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Leather[/b] to make sure your Visitors return home with a new pair of boots and dry feet.
[*]The [b]Tailor [/b]can now be upgraded with a [b]Clothing Shop[/b]. 
You can restock it with [b]Tier 2 Cloth[/b] and fulfill your visitors' wishes for some new fashionable clothes to take home.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The Music Button has been moved to the top left Corner Menu, and its functionality has been left unchanged.
[*]A New button has been added to the Recipe Crafting Menu to open the Ledger's Visitors' Orders.
[*]All Original Shop Stands had their Class Requirements reduced to [b]1[/b] down from [b]2[/b] to match those of the Beehive.
[*]Blacksmith's Tools Shop is now an exterior shop stand.[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a Bug that happened when moving objects and the control's tooltip wouldn't show.
[*]Fixed an issue causing Daily Quests limit to sometimes become minus.
[*]Improved the Visuals of Effects in Various Items.
[*]Cecil will now introduce the new Order System.
[*]Added an Option to Disable the Lightning Flashes during Thunderstorms in the Graphic Options.[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Known Issues:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fruit Juice crafted before this patch, will count for Visitors' Orders requesting apples. This will not occur with Fruit juice crafted after this patch.
[*] Existing versions of the game might need the Town's Ledger Hotkey to be manually assigned in the setting menu.
[/list]

notes.title: A Hero's Rest - Summer Sale Discount
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

To celebrate the Steam Summer Sale, you can pick “A Hero’s Rest” for [b]40% off[/b], in its biggest Discount for Early Access!

As we are working hard on our Content for the third Milestone, now is the perfect time to join in and start building up your very own Town to equip a brigade of Heroes.

[hr][/hr]
In the next Patch, we’ll be adding a whole new range of items to customize and decorate your shops.

You will now be able to place grass around the outside of your shops, to present your Heroes with a lush welcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/cbe2ebd9e44f78731c6a69a4db742c70ac2123ee.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
We’re working on a range of new decorations for you to place inside and outside your shops to make them even more appealing and attract more customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/7ee666764688723caae6abe9c6d4c3a789859f1e.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Next up we’ll introduce an entirely new system for your average visitors:

Visitors will now come to your town and place an order for a variety of their favourite Food and Potions. Fulfill their wishes to gain the visitors' appreciation and rewards for your Town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3c04556a14cbbb8acfb14a7e14b41a273313402e.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Version v0.520.27 Workstation Upgrades Part II
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With this new Patch we're bringing you the first additions of our third milestone: More Workstation Upgrades! 

Break down unwanted Items into their Materials, gather Tier 2 Resources on the Map and brew some fresh beer to make your Town even more successful.

We still have a lot of things planned before the Full Release of the game!

We hope you enjoy the new Update and we look forward to more things to come. 


[b]Patch Notes version v0.520.27:[/b]

[h1][b]New Upgrades:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Recycle Station:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/8a4fd2cbb94d6fe82193e25e4c73cbd71e5b9633.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Recycle Station is a new upgrade that can be placed at the Training Grounds to Recycle Unwanted gear into resources.
[*]You can Filter the items showing at the station by Shops, Item categories, Gear quality & Tier.
[*]Every Item has a chance to return some of the resources that were used when crafting it, the item will be lost in this process.
[*]You can select multiple items to recycle at once.
[*]A New Compendium Page has been added for this station.
[*]This is a [b]Unique[/b] Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Beer Keg:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/9a7e7c7a3a54dd88a10c0a8a6f3e8da4a9bd088d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Innkeeper has been working hard to bring a Beer Keg to always have a fresh Tankard of homebrewed goodness prepared for its customers.
[*]The Beer Keg will periodically generate Beer for you, which you can collect by clicking on the Beer Keg.
[*]To ensure you have the best Beer in Felonia, you will need a large amount of High-Quality Materials to add this boon to your Inn.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Iron Mine:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/4b3d4e56227680671369767f9b664dfa25b6df0f.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Your blacksmith dug deep to study the land and uncover hidden Ores, which allows you sometimes to find higher-quality metal from Ore deposits.
[*]Once built you will have a [b]25%[/b] chance to find Iron (T2 Metal) from the Natural Ore deposits scattered around the map.
[*][b]New Workstation Perk:[/b] Miner's Diary - increases the effects of the Iron Mine by an extra [b]15%[/b].
[*]This is a [b]Unique[/b] Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Saw Station:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f16dc6028bdb4fb9977c4547c526fe54464e41a2.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Saw Station allows your Woodworker to unlock their hidden potential and sometimes gain higher Quality Wood from Trees.
[*]Once built you will have a [b]25%[/b] chance to find Yew (T2 Wood) from some Trees scattered around the map.
[*][b]New Workstation Perk:[/b] Reforestation - increases the effects of the Saw Station by an extra [b]15%[/b].
[*]This is a [b]Unique[/b] Upgrade and therefore only one can be built.
[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The amount of potions crafted to get the free potion from the Potion Distillery has been reduced by [b]50%[/b]
[*]When Creating a new Template, the Template will now inherit the current name of the Item that is being saved.
[*]When Crafting a Template, the Template's name will now replace the current item's name. You may still randomize each craft's name in the same manner that you would randomize any other item's name.
[*]The Blacksmith's [b]Crystalized Dragon Essence[/b] Perk has been replaced with [b]Miner's Diary[/b].
[*]The Woodworker's [b]Crystalized Dragon Essence[/b] Perk has been replaced with [b]Reforestation[/b].
[*]The Blacksmith's and Woodworker's Perks have been reset in line with the new perks' arrival.
[*]New Icons have been added to the building tooltips to hint at whether the Item can be built Outdoors or Indoors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d39650e69a8f487c70cc7435e2c7fbb49706b480.png[/img]
[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a Bug where the notice board would generate more daily quests than intended.
[/list]

Happy Building!

notes.title: Patch Version v0.450.27 Crafting Templates
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're happy to wrap up our second Milestone on the Road to Release with this new Patch!
There are still lots of things to come, and we're excited to continue on this journey.

We prepared a video with the highlights of this month, and hope that you all enjoy the new Features
Happy crafting!

[previewyoutube=5dOAl-sxwHI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Patch Notes version v0.450.27:[/b]

[h1][b]New Features:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Crafting Templates:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to save your favourite gear designs as Templates in the Crafting Menu
[*]Templates will allow you to quickly access different designs you made and assign them to specific active Classes to improve the overall dress code of your town.
[*]You can have up to 8 Templates per item type which can be distinguished by different Badges, for more than 100+ Templates in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a2c6d3b4dc09657b5446668b190a746605daac6c.png[/img]
[*]Once a Template is saved, its appearance can't be changed, but you can further modify the template's settings at will.
[*]Classes may have multiple Templates assigned to them.
[*]Template items will have a distinguished Template Logo appear in all the Inventory windows.
[*]Deleting a Template will cause all crafted items still in the Inventory crafted from that Template to reset and no longer have any Template associated with them.
[*]A New Compendium Page has been dedicated to Template Crafting.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]A New Filter has been added to the Tailor's "Extras" inventory to filter between Foci and other accessories, in the same fashion items are filtered for the other shops.
[*]Heroes that die in combat while on a quest, will now have the quest's name displayed in the retired screen.
[*]The Compendium Entry about Heroes' needs has been updated to include the changes added with the Template System.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Vendors' AI & Pathing to restock production farms allowing them to restock in more complex scenarios.
[*]Fixed a crash that would happen when trying to customize T4 Heavy Armour.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Version v0.440.27 Workstation Upgrades Part I

notes.title: v0.410.27 Hotfix
notes.notes:

Just in time with the Steam Spring Sale, we bring you our latest Milestone Patch: The Vendor Overhaul!

Each Vendor now has their own specialization tree with many different bonuses for you to choose from and, on top of that, will now be able to assist you in managing your resource farms.

We hope you enjoy the new Update!

[b]Patch Notes version v0.410.27:[/b]

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[b]Station Specialization:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vendors have been completely overhauled and now feature the station specialization system which can be accessed from their detail's menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/f0161acacb500389f68ade0f6ec7dbf3a996dd5c.png[/img]
[*]By clicking on the Vendor you will now be able to open the Details menu and choose from over [b]50[/b] perks spread across all the crafting stations, which will allow you to focus your stations on doing what you want them to, in the most effective way possible.

[*]Restocking fee varies on the Game Difficulty, and the vendor will be unavailable to serve your customers while taking the task. Making sure you have Shop Displays available, will ensure that customers stay entertained during this time.
[*]Before Sending the Vendor to Restock the farms a tooltip will display the estimated price for the restocking, if the vendor fails to restock any of the farms you will receive a notification for a reason & no cost will be deducted from the player. [/list][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Patch Version v0.400.27 Active Pause
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As always we are keen on your feedback and doing our best to implement your ideas to fit our vision for the game. Today we are releasing the latest patch for A Hero's Rest, including some of the most requested features to date.

To make it easier we put together a patch-highlight video, for those who prefer to get the news in that format.

[previewyoutube=tdM_4mIsOBQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[b]As always, below, Patch notes for Version v0.400.27:[/b]

[h1][b]New Features:[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Active Pause:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]This highly requested feature, will allow you to pause the game and take the time you need to craft, build, manage your inventory and more.
[*]Active Pause can be accessed by clicking the pause icon in the Speed controls or by pressing the slow speed hotkey [b][1][/b] twice.
[*]Some upgrades & actions that require time to pass will not be available during pause.
[*]Active pause can be used in all difficulties.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e2ec88158cd0a1ed973757f67c633e584deb546c.gif[/img][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Daily Quests: [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Quests can now be set as daily from the inventory menu. This will allow you to set a specific number of quests to be repeatable and automatically post them once they are taken by Heroes. 
[*]The Standard posting fee applies when posting a quest in this manner. If you don't have the resources to re-post that quest, the quest will be removed by the Hero taking it and you will receive a Warning Notification of what quest failed to re-post.
[*]Daily quests are limited and are unlocked by defeating new Bosses that threaten your Town for a total of [b]10[/b] Daily Quests, with an additional [b]2[/b] quests given for reaching Barren Reputation in [b]Relaxing difficulty[/b].
[*]A counter in the Inventory window will show how many Daily Quests you have still available.
[*]With the introduction of Daily Quests, the maximum quest limit has been decreased to [b]5[/b]/[b]8[/b]/[b]12[/b]/[b]18[/b]/[b]30[/b] down from [b]5[/b]/[b]10[/b]/[b]14[/b]/[b]20[/b]/[b]99[/b] from Deserted to Glamorus respectively.
[*]Daily Quests can also be set as High Priority or Reserved to a specific Hero in the same fashion that normal quests can.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ef5a9f20984b8a2147f1575a894b28048f55c6cd.png[/img][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Hero Retention:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]When the Hero's Morale is depleted, they will now protest in front of the innkeeper for a day's length, during this time you will have the opportunity to pay off the hero and convince them to stay at the price of [b]500[/b]/[b]1000[/b]/[b]1500[/b] gold per Hero Level based on the current difficulty.
[*]Selecting a protesting Hero will prompt a pop-up in the Hero Sheet, that will allow you to pay the Hero's Demanded sum, or release them from your roster immediately.
[*]Heroes that are compensated, will continue their business as usual and finish their shopping routine. They will also have their morale restored to Neutral (50%). 
[*]If the Hero protesting is in your favourites list, a notification will inform you that he is considering retiring.
[*]Heroes that are not paid off in time, will permanently retire from your Hero roster.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ea941c3b29a351bb95c7e0573487dc1ad121a722.png[/img][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]New Proficiency: Focus[/b][/h3]
introducing a new set of Items for your Heroes - Magic Focus! Equip your heroes with everything they need to succeed in their journey, with 32 new customizable foci that can be crafted at the Tailor.
The Foci are the ideal item to boost your Heroes' Intelligence and bring a mystic appeal to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d6c504aaa6de36e1c92040af05ceeb878afd4e20.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]When checking classes in the Class Manager, it will now display the number of Heroes currently recruited for each class.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/12d8bd0206fc89d1d690b48d9ed056413c2a344c.png[/img]
[*]When Hovering over the fast travel buttons to check the Vendor's Stock, it will now [b]show the stock in detail[/b] for the separated categories at a glance.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/a7fb54a16cb17996d07db50fa8a1564e69ec88dd.png[/img][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved the tracking of the Trader & weapon Master through gameplay sessions, reducing the spawn time of either, especially during the period of short sessions
[*]Fixed a bug where in some maps teleporting to the Traveller's camp would cause the camera to fall through the ground.

notes.title: Patch Version v0.304.27 Difficulty Re-Balance
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

We are happy to bring our newest patch for the game, introducing a lot of balancing changes & improvements with a focus to increase challenge & flow, especially in the Challenging & Hardcore Difficulties. 

The goal was to keep the relaxing difficulty relaxing for those who enjoy the building aspects of the game. While improving the challenge and replayability of the harder difficulties while also improving their pace.

[b]Patch Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Prosperity System.
[*]Improved Resource Gain.
[*]Improved Threat System.
[*]Crafting Recipies changes.
[*]New Stockpiles, Features & Improvements.
[/list]
Later this month, we will be bringing another patch with a lot of new & requested features that we teased in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2016080/view/3671031422445286689?l=english]January Dev Log[/url] last week. 

Happy week everyone! 

Loke & Chaya 🤓
[hr][/hr][hr][/hr][b]Below, Patch notes for Version v0.304.27:[/b]


[h3][b]Difficulty Changes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resources needed for crafting at the workstations, have been normalized across all difficulties.
[*]Overwhelming Quests will now provide extra rewards in the same fashion Challenging Quests do.
[*]When [b]"At Risk"[/b] prosperity or worse, a tax penalty of [b]10%/20%/35%[/b] is applied by the king based on the current game difficulty. The Penalty can be seen in the new reputation tooltip. (see below)[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slightly Improved resource gain from quests, especially for Hardcore Difficulty.
[*]Increased resource gain from natural resources in all the difficulties.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Reputation Changes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Town Prosperity - The Current Lose Condition has been replaced by this feature. In addition to Reputation, Prosperity plays a major role in the success of your town. Losing your Prosperity could lead to [b]game over[/b].

[*]There are 3 stages of Prosperity to look out for:

[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/80326bbb30f38469b2088274873e3d672dcd3c6b.png[/img] [b]Good[/b] - By keeping a Positive Balance & good King's Approval, Your Town is safe and thriving
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ec0c7891faf0dce4b60508d8a93bbb67684dadde.png[/img] [b]At Risk[/b] - Your actions have caught the attention of the king and a negative balance could lead to Bad Prosperity.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/d59ada04835321931d5a1c11f43a4758da7ae1dd.png[/img] [b]Bad[/b] - At this stage, you are given until midnight to improve your current balance or you will lose the game. (The Game Over screen has been left unchanged. This means you can continue your playthrough but Platform specific achievements will no longer be unlocked.)
[/list][/list][i]*We will continue to expand on this feature as we implement new systems into the game.[/i]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reputation Penality during evaluation, for going into Negative Balance, has been reduced to a third of its current value to a max of [b]-20[/b] Reputation points.
[*]Refusing a King's Request will have its reputation & prosperity effects take place immediately and will set your town into "At Risk" Prosperity. These effects will last [b]1-4[/b] days.
[*]Having a Negative evaluated balance will put your town into "At Risk" Prosperity, this can be amended by having a positive balance by your next evaluation.
[/list]
[b]Reputation ToolTip:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Reputation Breakdown Tooltip has been reworked to include your current Reputation (Deserted, Barren, etc....) and your prosperity. It will now also appear when hovering over your Reputation Stars.
[*]The Current Fame Tooltip Has been Removed & Replaced by the Reputation Breakdown.
[*]Increased the Size of the Reputation Breakdown UI for better readability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/56ab87dc50ed2fcb4cbebb9b2c6269a627d66d36.png[/img][/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Threat Changes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Failed Threats in [b]Challenging & Hardcore Difficulty[/b] had their Penalty reworked and will become [b]more challenging[/b] even for the wealthiest of towns. This in effect, will also [b]increase[/b] the [b]constitution Heroes' effectiveness[/b], in their role of defending your losses.
[*]Max Threats have been [b]increased[/b] in the end-game in all difficulties.
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Threats will now be [b]more varied[/b] and [b]challenging[/b], reducing the likelihood of receiving low-level threats like goblins, in the end-game.
[*]Threats Gold Rewards have been [b]Doubled[/b] across all difficulties.
[*]Threats Material Rewards have been [b]increased[/b], especially when rewarding T1 Resources across all difficulties
[*][b]Reduced[/b] the Interval Between Threats.
[*]Rare threats had their Time limit decreased to [b]8[/b] days from [b]10[/b].
[*]Legendary Threats had their time decreased in Challenging & Hardcore Difficulties to [b]12[/b] and [b]10[/b] days Respectivly.
[/list][hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Crafting Changes:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Quest Crafting Menu has been improved to show the available Tier rewards for each objective, along with tooltips to explain the new dynamic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/9a2de0194cb047280ea58cd354b6d114ec0006a4.png[/img]
[*]A [b]New Potion[/b] has been added to the Apothecary - [b]Greater Potion of Vigor[/b] is a Tier 4 Potion that will improve the Hero's Morale by 35% when taken.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/3486e93c0f9ace3d467cb2ff40092dfc9a9a0941.png[/img]
[*]A New Filter has been added to the Tailor's "Extras" inventory to filter between Backpacks & Capes in the same fashion items are filtered for the other shops.
[*]Reserved Potions Drop Down Menu will now also display the Hero's CR.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3]Craft Balancing:[/h3]

[b]Apothecary:[/b]
[list]
[*]Potion of Confidence has been moved to [b]T1[/b] Potion down from [b]T2[/b] and had its price adjusted to fit the new crafting level.
[*]Potion of Haste has been moved to [b]T2[/b] up from [b]T1[/b] and had its price adjusted to fit the new crafting level.
[*]Potion of Plentiness had its effect increased to [b]25%[/b] up from [b]20%[/b].
[/list]
[b]Transmutation Station:[/b] (Boss unlocks changed)
[list]
[*]Defeating the [b]Goblin Chieftain[/b] will now unlock Tier 2 Transmutation at the Transmutation Station.
[*]Defeating the [b]Bandit Leader[/b] will now unlock Tier 3 Transmutation at the Transmutation Station.
[*]Defeating the [b]Defiler[/b] will now unlock Tier 4 Transmutation at the Transmutation Station.
[/list]
[b]Innkeeper:[/b]
[list]
[*] High-Quality recipes of Food Tier 2 and above will now provide a [b]Morale Bonus[/b] to the Hero.
The bonus is affected by the crafted item quality. (This will not affect already crafted items)
[/list]
[b]Blacksmith:[/b]
[list]
[*]One Handed Swords & off-handed swords had their Cost reduced across all tiers.
[*]Daggers & Off-hand Daggers had their Cost reduced across all tiers.
[*]Heavy Armours had their cost reduced and will require fewer resources to craft in Tier 1 & 4.
[/list]
[b]WoodWorker:[/b]
[list]
[*]Shields had their Cost reduced across all tiers.
[*]Polearms Tier 2 will now require [b]Leather T1[/b] instead of [b]Wood T1[/b] as an Ingredient.
[*]Polearms Tier 3 will now require [b]Leather T1[/b] instead of [b]Metal T1[/b] as an Ingredient.
[/list]
[b]Tanner:[/b]
[list]
[*]Medium Armours had their cost reduced and will require fewer resources to craft in Tier 1 & 4.
[/list]
[b]Tailor:[/b]
[list]
[*]Light Armours had their cost reduced and will require fewer resources to craft in Tier 1 & 4.
[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Miscellaneous:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New:[/h3]
[list]
[*]All existing [b]stockpiles[/b] have been turned into [b]small stockpiles[/b], their required size has been adjusted
to better fit the crates' placement.
[*][b]Medium Stockpile[/b] - New furniture under the workstation menu provides [b]25[/b] stock capacity.
[*][b]Large Stockpile[/b] - New furniture under the workstation menu provides [b]40[/b] stock capacity.
[*]Selecting a New Speed using the Speed Hotkeys while the speed controls are disabled (ex. during transitions or Crafting), will now set to the desired speed once the controls are re-enabled.
[/list]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The [b]Reserved Filter button[/b] in the Inventory has been replaced with a button that will better represent the selected filter setting. Furthermore, it will flash promptly to alert the player whenever the player attempts to reserve a quest for a specific Hero.
[*][b]Reduced[/b] the Interval between King Requests.
[*]Updated Mr. George's Tutorial to reflect the new losing conditions.
[*][b]Improved[/b] the visibility of resources during crafting.
[*]Fireplace had its price reduced to 2 Wood [b]T1[/b] Down from [b]T2[/b]
[*]The Achievement [b]"Just a humble servant"[/b] had its milestone requirements [b]reduced[/b] to [b]5/15/30[/b] down from [b]5/20/50[/b].
[*]Items will now show the [b]Success bonus[/b] they provide when [b]Hovering over[/b] the items in the Hero's Inventory.
[*]When closing a crafting menu while the crafting pop-up is open, the menu will now close the pop-up with it.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]When earning an achievement, the game speed will no longer lock to normal until the Achievement is dismissed.
[*]When completing Royal Requests, the game speed will no longer lock to normal until the requests is dismissed.
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing lost games to still unlock Platform achievements during loading.
[*]Potions at the Apothecary have been re-arranged and some of the Icons have been replaced.
[*]Changed the Robes Category at the Tailor Station to "Light Armour" to coincide with the 
Weapon Master's Options and better represent the available parts options.
[*]A Bug where it was possible to take advantage of extras without paying the full price for
their craft has been resolved.
[*]Heroes without quests will no longer show green (bonus) Reward text on the Hero list.
[/list]

notes.title: January Dev-Log
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We want to give you all a quick update on what's going on behind the scenes for "A Hero's Rest"!

[hr][/hr]
We've recently released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2016080/view/6808913285550217268?l=english]first part[/url] of the next Patch to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2016080/discussions/1/3386168507491872427/?snr=]Beta Branch[/url], which includes a bunch of changes to the balancing of the game.

We're introducing an overhaul to the Reputation System, so you'll have to make sure to keep the King happy! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/56ab87dc50ed2fcb4cbebb9b2c6269a627d66d36.png[/img]

This comes with changes to the way you can lose the game, as the King will now cut you some slack if he has a good opinion of you, but will not be so generous if he is unhappy. 

The Beta Branch also includes a bunch of changes to recipes, including a new potion, improvements to the Quest Crafting UI, and changes to the cost of crafting items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/9a2de0194cb047280ea58cd354b6d114ec0006a4.png[/img] 
[hr][/hr]
But there are still a lot of things in the making!

As many people have requested, we are adding a [b]Pause Mode[/b] with the next Patch, so you can take your time whenever you need to.
You will be able to craft, build and manage your Heroes and Inventory while making sure you don't miss anything going on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/e2ec88158cd0a1ed973757f67c633e584deb546c.gif[/img]
Adding to this, we are introducing a new way to make sure to keep your favourite Heroes around. Instead of just deciding to leave you and your whole Town behind, you will have a "grace period" where you can decide to convince them to stay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/2aa6393c4ecd1bc554511d502040759d7230fde8.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
We're also adding another set of equipment to the game, the new Back Item "Focus".
You will be able to craft Foci at the Tailor and equip your Heroes with another Set of magical Items to give their class a unique look and bolster their ability to take on the toughest Quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481174/ee4480c9607ca1e96275f27a5c21e8853a3bc55d.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
We're very excited to be sharing this journey with all of you, and hope you are enjoying the game and looking forward to what else we have in store for you during the Early Access Period.

Loke & Chaya ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: Patch Version v0.300.27 QOL Part II
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. 

We are happy to bring our newest update - Quality of Life Part II. In this update, we took on several aspects of the game that needed some polishing and we did everything in our power to improve the gameplay experience. 

Also as announced last week, we are opening our beta branch. For details on how to access it, check the bottom of this announcement.

Looking forward we will be posting our Roadmap in the next few days to give you all a glance at our plans for the future of "A Hero's Rest" 

Without further ado, Patch notes for Version v0.300.27

[b]Difficulty Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Games that have received the [b]Game-Over[/b] Screen and continued will no longer be able to receive Steam Achievements during that playthrough. Milestones will continue to unlock normally but achievements will not be rewarded for gaining them. This is to reward players that haven't lost the game during their playthrough. [b]This will affect new & existing games, achievements that have already been earned this way will not be changed[/b].
[*]When playing in [b]Relaxing[/b] difficulty Heroes will now consider leaving the town once their Morale is below [b]20%[/b], down from the previous [b]40%[/b], gradually increasing the chance as it reaches 0%. This is not Retroactive and will only affect games created after this patch.
[/list]
[b]Accessibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Keybinds for Rotating the camera with the Keyboard, these can be changed in the
Control section of the Settings menu.
[*]The Zoom in / Out with the keyboard has been reworked and will now work properly.
[*]Added a New Slider to the control section of the settings menu to adjust the speed in 
which you zoom in / out when using your zoom, This affects both keyboard & Mouse Zoom.
[/list]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Message log has been reworked, Now you are able to filter what's displayed in the log
by Consumables / Gear / Quests and Other (Like Restocks or Bee-Hive Sales) notifications.
[*]The Message Log can now be resized by dragging the new button on the right corner of the log.
The left button can still be used to instantly collapse or expand the log.
[*]Quests will now automatically generate a name based on the quest's context.
[*]Gear Items can now be renamed after crafting by selecting them via the inventory menu.
[*]New options at the trader now allow you to sell all broken / Bad Items in your shops
and also give you the ability to buy/sell Materials in Bulk of 1/5/10. Remember that when
buying / selling in bulk you are still subject to the supply & demand rate changes.
[*]Mousing over the Hero Helmet next to your hero count UI to show the tooltip, will now
also show the current town population, formed by Heroes & Visitors.
[*]Crafting menus will now display the current stock of products belonging to the shop. It's now
possible to quickly open the inventory corresponding to the shop by pressing the button next to the stock.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Heroes' upgrading logic has been improved. They will now be smarter about upgrading, increasing
their effectiveness while reducing situations where they would get morale penalties.
[*]When Checking a Hero's inventory it will now be possible to see the current Item Tier represented
at the bottom of the tooltip.
[*]Crafters will now improve their crafting skills of lower tier items as they level up, the better the crafter, the higher the chances they will craft a quality item for all Tiers.
[*]Rare Items should now be easier to distinguish in the Hero Inventory.
[*]Hovering over the Heroes CR-Ranges in the top left of the Hero Manager will now display the number of Heroes currently displayed in the list.
[*]The Visitors are back! Visitors will flock to your town more regularly as your population increases. Previously visitors became scarce as your hero population increased, this is now changed and they will make sure to return for those shop stands in your shops!
[*]While in Popular reputation, Quest limit has been increased to [b]20[/b] up from [b]15[/b]
[*]We reworked the wording of the threats when you mouse over the images, to make them more engaging and explanatory of your objectives.
[*]The Icon displaying Decorations in the Details panel of the vendors has been replaced.
[*]Rephrased the QuestBoard's Tooltip to better guide new players on how to place it down. 
[/list]
[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the text size in the quest name for better readability.
[*]The Season summary will now properly reward players that have reached the soft cap of 50 Hereos and have not lost or gained Heroes during the season in review.
[*]The inventory Window will now be more responsive when switching categories or vendors, This is especially noticeable when owning a large number of inventory items.
[*]When switching between quest objectives, custom Quest names will no longer reset once chosen.
[*]Fixed a bug where Item Images were missing their images in the inventory window when loading a cloud save into a different computer or System.
[*]Fixed a bug that would occur under certain conditions, that would lock players from opening windows or exiting the game. (We will continue to investigate this but we believe we covered the cause of the bug if this happens during your play you can QuickSave [F5 by default] and QuickLoad [F9 by default].)
[*]A Bug that allowed players to make some profit from the Trader in Hardcore Difficulty has been fixed. This is no longer possible to replicate.
[*]Fixed a bug where very unfortunate heroes would find themselves lost in thought at the entrance of the town, never to continue their Heroic journeys.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Weapon master wouldn't move back to his station's location if the Station
Was only moved slightly off from its original location. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Playing on the  Beta Branch: [/b]

While this branch will grant access to new content there are a few things that are important to mention, and it's very important that you [b]Backup[/b] Your Save before ever playing in this branch.
[list]
[*]The Beta Branch will receive frequent updates while a big update is in the works for the main branch of the game.
[*]The Beta Branch is unstable and it may have more bugs / and possible game-breaking problems while the content is in production, [b]Save Games[/b] may be corrupted and lost, it's important to [b]Backup[/b] Your saves before playing in this branch.
[*]The Beta Branch will allow us to test features earlier and with greater feedback than we could possibly accomplish in-house, allowing us to provide better and bug-free updates.
[*]The Content in the Beta Branch is a work in progress and [b]always[/b] subject to change, It's advised to not take the features released there as set in stone.
[*]The Beta Branch will only be used for bigger updates. Some smaller ones will be pushed to the main branch without a testing period in the beta branch as long as we know it's safe to do so.  
[/list]
[b]The Main Branch is and will always be the most stable and up-to-date version to play the game, and the only official version supported.[/b]

[b]Accessing the Beta Branch:[/b]

In Order to play on the beta branch all you need to do is the following steps.
[list]
[*]Open the context menu by Right clicking "A Hero's Rest" in your library and go to [b]properties[/b].
[*]Go to [b]Betas[/b] and Select "Beta - Unstable Build"
[*]You are ready to go, steam should download the beta version of the game and give You access to the build currently active. 
[/list]
At the time of this release, the beta branch and the main branch will be identical but this may change in the future when we work or larger patches.
[hr][/hr]
[b]Credits:[/b]

[I]Thanks to JS from the Discord Server for sharing with us the Heroic picture of the announcement.[/i]

If you would like to have your own heroes featured in our announcements or events, head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/y9ytRDnYzU]Discord Channel[/url], and share your pictures in the Picture-Galore Channel.
